result:
I searched the repo for every file that uses `Role` as a type. That means type annotations, type arguments, `Record<Role, …>` keys, and imports from `@/types/member`. I also checked for aliased imports and imports through the `@/types` barrel, and found none.

The list includes `src/types/member.ts`, where the union and `ROLE_RANK: Record<Role, number>` are defined. The main places that will break at compile time when a new role is added are the `Record<Role, …>` maps:
- `ROLE_RANK` in `src/types/member.ts`
- `TONE_BY_ROLE` in `src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx`
- `ROLE_LABELS` in `src/lib/format.ts`
- `actors` and `userIds` in `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`

`src/schemas/role.ts` also has a compile-time check that its schema's roles match the `Role` union.

Some files are left out on purpose:
- `scripts/manifest-parts/*.ts` and `scripts/build-manifest.ts` only mention `Role` inside description strings.
- Files like `invitation-list.tsx` only use "Role" as UI text.
- Files that pass bare string literals such as `"member"` don't name the type, so they're out of scope.

ANSWER: src/types/member.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/permission.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, src/emails/invite-email.tsx, src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/schemas/role.ts, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx, src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx, src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx, src/lib/permissions.ts, src/lib/format.ts, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts, tests/components/role-select.test.ts, tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts
